description: Implement automatic synchronization between the UI theme and export theme at the start of each session. Users should be able to override the export theme during their current session, but the synchronization should reset to match the UI theme when the page is reloaded.
functional_requirements: Initialize the export theme to match the current UI theme at the start of each session
Allow users to change the export theme independently during their current session
Reset the export theme to match the UI theme when the page is reloaded or the session restarts
Update the export dialog UI to reflect the current export theme setting
Ensure the export functionality uses the currently selected export theme
Maintain backward compatibility with existing export theme preferences during the session
